subject: Private deployment: availability constraints & security reviewer request
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medvance.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Private deployment interest — initial intake and timeline

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — we just completed the self-serve intake and selected 'Private (VPC/on-prem)'. I wanted to reach out directly to accelerate scheduling. High-level: MedVance is evaluating a HIPAA-aligned on-prem pilot for a near-production workload (tenant isolation + HSM integration).

Couple of constraints up-front:
- Our security reviewer (Ravi Shah) is only available afternoons CET next week (13:00–17:00 CET).
- We need a 60–75 minute deep-dive that covers network requirements, KMS options, and audit-log access.
- We will request SOC 2 evidence and a short checklist before the call.

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week that include an ops/solutions engineer? Priyom — looping you for SDR scheduling. Neha — would you join to cover compliance questions?

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Varga
Director, Cloud Security Programs
MedVance Health
elena.varga@medvance.com
+44 20 7946 0712
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medvance.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private deployment interest — initial intake and timeline

Elena — thanks for the context and for flagging Ravi's availability. We can absolutely run the 60–75 min technical/compliance deep-dive. Quick notes and a proposed path: 

- Proposed attendees from our side: Marcus Lin (solutions), Neha Kapoor (security/compliance), and an infra engineer (TBD).
- Proposed agenda (60–75m): 1) network & VPC peering, 2) KMS/HSM options and key custody, 3) audit logs & retention, 4) pilot success criteria and next steps.
- I'll attach a short private-deploy checklist (answers will help Ravi prep).

Priyom — can you open availability for these candidate windows (all CET):
- Tue 21 Dec, 14:30–15:45 CET
- Wed 22 Dec, 15:00–16:15 CET
- Thu 23 Dec, 13:00–14:15 CET

If none work, share two options and we'll prioritize Ravi's afternoon preference. Also please confirm we can include an ops engineer (I expect to bring Sanjay from infra; he can join the later slot).

Attachment: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (short checklist — 1 page)

Looking forward,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Private deployment interest — initial intake and timeline

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the checklist and agenda. Quick update:
- Ravi (copied) confirms only Wed/Thu afternoons CET next week; Tue is fully blocked for him.
- Our security operations prefers the later window on Wed if possible (15:30 CET onward).
- We also need the call recorded (for internal reviewers) and a short pre-call doc with the exact audit log fields you expose (or a sample).

Can you do Wed 22 Dec 15:30–16:45 CET and include the ops engineer + a note that you'll share the sample audit-log fields before the call?

Also — does Redwood have a standard evidence bundle for SOC 2 requests (can be redacted)? If you can attach a stub now, we can use it for our procurement checklist.

Best,
Elena
